LiHua describes this instance as "insane," highlighting Messi's exceptional footwork and dribbling skills, which made the play seem effortless. This dribble past multiple defenders left an indelible impression on LiHua, illustrating why Messi's abilities are considered mesmerizing and why this particular moment stands out as a favorite.
